output.reason: Operator/attention semantics, numeric/source binding, and board/runtime traceability admit independent specialist review followed by a single evidence gate. All six supplied deterministic checks pass; these current hash-bound facts should be reused rather than subjected to later-stage simulation or synthesis prerequisites. SACG memory truth nevertheless identifies two active contamination barriers, with no open retry or backtrack requests. Review must distinguish the current candidate from rejected artifacts and resolve whether the recorded 1152 versus 4*256 dimensional concern has any concrete current-source basis, without assuming that model width must equal projected attention width or changing trusted templates to force equality.

handoff_rule.acceptance: Canonical checks accept the reviewed coverage and binding contracts, and every semantic objection has an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
handoff_rule.on_failure: Deliver the exact missing semantic or contradictory interface to the gate; preserve rejected evidence as debug-only and request bounded repair or approval rather than changing model dimensions.
handoff_rule.on_success: Deliver a complete coverage and semantic disposition tied to the current candidate and source hashes; share dimensional findings without making the parallel binding review wait for this task.
